description: Uncollected Goods: notices under the Disposal of Uncollected Goods Act by auctioneers, garages and storage yards - the owner must collect the goods and pay charges by a deadline, or they will be sold.

issuer.description: Auctioneer, garage or yard giving the notice.

issuer_location.description: Where the goods are held, as printed.

registration_number.description: Vehicle registration, e.g. 'KCA 123A', if a vehicle.

owner.description: Owner or person who left the goods, if named.

collection_deadline.description: Date or period by which the owner must collect, as printed (e.g. 'within thirty (30) days').

charges.description: Storage or repair charges the owner must pay, if stated.

contact.description: Address or telephone for the owner to contact.
